entities.summary: Johan Per Harju is a Swedish former professional ice hockey forward who last played with HC Pustertal Wölfe of the ICE Hockey League (ICEHL). He was selected by the Tampa Bay Lightning in the 6th round of the 2007 NHL Entry Draft.
